links.desc: Get the contents of the config at the requested path. Single or multiple values may be returned. NOTE: This cannot be applied to the root.

options.desc: String of the JSON dot path into the config. Only required as a query option when not specified in the URL.
Boolean value to request value object data in collapsed (list) form. Default is 'true'.
Boolean value to request value object data in expanded (object) form. Default is 'false'.

result.path: String containing the requested path. Keys in 'expanded' and 'collapsed' are relative to this path.
result.type: Type string of the result. Primitive types are {'string'|'integer'|'number'|'boolean'}. Compound types are {'object'|'array'}.
result.value: String representation of the value mapped to path, if result is a primitive type.
result.collapsed: Map of expanded relative key paths to values, if requested and applicable to the returned type.
result.expanded: Nested object of values, if requested and applicable to the returned type.

links.desc: Set values in the config. Single or multiple values may be set.

options.desc: String of the JSON dot path of the desired write location in the config. Only required as a query option when not specified in the URL.
A single value to be written to the destination path. If using this, do not set 'collapsed' or 'expanded'.
Map of relative paths to values. This is the same format as returned by GET with 'collapsed=true'. If using this, do not set 'value' or 'expanded'.
Nested object of values in expanded (object) form. This is the same format as returned by GET with 'expanded=true'. If using this, do not set 'value' or 'collapsed'.

Flag indicating that the data should be appended to the array at 'path'. Requires that 'path' is the path to an array, and that the provided data in the collapsed/expanded keys have the correct fields as required by the schema.
If the value is a dynamic object name being appended to an array, and that object only requires a single value, use this to set the value for that object.

successResponse.result: If an array 'append' was requested, then this variable will be path string of the created element, else this variable is not defined.

links.desc: Remove an element from an array in the config.

options.desc: String of the JSON dot path of the array element to be removed. Only required as a query option when not specified in the URL.

links.desc: Get the children keys of an object at the requested path. NOTE: This cannot be applied to the root.

options.desc: String of the JSON dot path of the object to retrieve keys from. Only required as a query option when not specified in the URL.

successResponse.result: Array of strings of child keys

links.desc: Get the changes made on the current config (where defaults are overwritten).

options.desc: String of the JSON dot path of the object to retrieve the changes of. Only required as a query option when not specified in the URL.

successResponse.result: Nested JSON object of the changes from the default configuration
